digest.component_or_area: store ensure units / git index management
propositions: 119 */.archived and 126 */.write.lock files are tracked in tickets branch HEAD despite .gitignore patterns, causing git status to report spurious working-tree deletions when markers are created/destroyed locally
Dirty git status breaks the strict head check in tracker_head_sha and triggers merge-abort variant (b), breaking plan-review close attestations
An ensure unit untrack-runtime-markers must remove tracked marker files from git index via git rm --cached (idempotent, zero commits on re-run, worktree files untouched)
Peers merging the untrack commit have their worktree markers deleted by git; reader must self-heal missing .archived markers by re-materializing them when compiled state says archived
